import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { rental } from "../../../backend/schema/rental";

export const rentalCms = customizeTable<typeof rental>("rental", {
    display: {
        title: "uuid"
    },
    sort: ["lastUpdate", "desc"],
    listFields: ["rentalId", "uuid", "rentalDate", "returnDate", "lastUpdate", "inventory"],
    fields: {
        lastUpdate: {
            readOnly: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "rentalId",
        "uuid",
        "rentalDate",
        "returnDate",
        "lastUpdate",
        "inventory",
        "customer",
        "staff"
    ]
});
